fields.description: Human-friendly name, e.g. Singapore. The record's Name (e.g. ap-south-1) is the provider's own region code, and is what Grove sends to the API.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The residency boundary this region is in. Every box here inherits it. Fixed while a Network or Machine names the region.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: Central's name for the region whose datum this is (its own Region doc, e.g. blr-1): the audience of every token Grove mints for boxes here. Grove's region codes need not match Central's.
fields.label: Central Region

fields.description: datum's remote write route for this region, e.g. https://telemetry-svc.bom.frappe.cloud/v1/ingest/remote (https: datum's proxy answers http with a 308 that Vector drops). Every Monitoring Agent and every Vector in this region pushes to it; there is no fleet-wide fallback.
fields.label: Metrics Endpoint

fields.description: datum's log route for this region, e.g. https://telemetry-svc.bom.frappe.cloud/v1/logs/ingest (https, as above). Every box here POSTs its journald and pathway/redis lines to it.
fields.label: Logs Endpoint

fields.description: When the kept roster token runs out. Grove asks Central for a new one just before.
fields.label: Datum Token Expires At
